passages.note: Roll call 70 shows Thompson voting Yea on HJR 3's 3rd reading, final passage, 57-40.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Enrolled HJR 3 adds this as new Section 38 of Article 1 of the Indiana Constitution; this is the provision Thompson's Yea vote enacted toward passage.

rows.reasoning: Thompson voted Yea on HJR 3 (2014), final 3rd-reading passage of a single-subject joint resolution whose sole operative text states only a marriage between one man and one woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana, with no provision for civil unions or other recognition. This matches the rung text 'Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.'
